Definition
[Weak stationary pressure] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0103 1. ch29:29.13\group Backward Pressure Limit

A function $\widetilde v\in W^{1,2}(S^2)$ is a weak solution of the stationary pressure equation if \[ \int _{S^2} igl(-\widetilde v\langle abla \widetilde v, abla \varphi angle -| abla \widetilde v|^2\varphi +2\widetilde v^2\varphi igr) \, d\mu _{S^2}=0 \] for every smooth test function $\varphi $.
